claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows devices heavily wrapped in masking and electrical tape, consistent with damaged or scrap goods.
Location cannot be determined from the photos of the devices.

risks.risk: Internal battery cells are missing or replaced with weights
risks.proof: A video of the devices being weighed on a digital scale or opened.

risks.risk: Battery cells are swollen, leaking, or a fire hazard
risks.proof: Photos of the devices with all tape removed to inspect the casing.
Photos of the manufacturer labels or a USB capacity tester reading.

proof_requests: Photos of the devices with all tape removed.
Photos of any manufacturer labels or specifications printed on the casing.
A video showing the devices successfully charging a phone.
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as power banks and the seller explicitly labels them as scrap. They can be priced at the baseline value for non-functional or damaged lithium-ion battery scrap.
